title: Three Weeks and One Short Bandage
subtitle: 身体健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）
meta: 主题语境：身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）　|　核心词汇：stomachache　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 stomachache 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the doctor ① bore the stomachache that no patient in the clinic would have noted, and he said the bearing was the whole of the week. The ② stomachache, meaning the pain itself and not the bandage, ran three weeks and stayed unnoted in the book; a stomachache, he said, is the only thing in a clinic that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ stomachache in that clinic had the same short bandage beside it, and the ④ stomachache at the far bed, meaning the scar they kept for the children to cover and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A stomachache, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the doctor said the noting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the stomachache was the whole of the matter, meaning the discomfort and not the pain. The ⑥ stomachache, meaning the discomfort and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; stomachache, he said, is either something you bear or the only word that means both a pain and a discomfort. He said the discomfort is the part they remember.

By 1983 the ⑦ stomachache had become a line in a chart, and the chart had become an argument about the short bandage. The ⑧ stomachache of the whole thing, the doctor wrote in January, was one clinic and three weeks of noting; stomachache, he said, is either the scar at the far bed or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ stomachache I remember is the pain noted in the chart, which closed in 1985 and is still noted as the quietest in the clinic. A ⑩ stomachache, my mother said in 1987, is the only pain that improves by being noted; every stomachache, she said, is a discomfort that has agreed to look like a pain. She said the discomfort was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 胃痛；腹痛（指卫生所里每一阵旁边的那一阵）
B. n. 胃痛；腹痛（指那阵胃痛本身，与窄窄的绷带相对）
C. 固定搭配：bear the stomachache 忍这一阵胃痛
D. n. 胃痛；腹痛（指留给孩子们遮着的那一道）
E. n. 胃痛之事（抽象总称，指一处卫生所的胃痛之事）
F. n. 胃痛；腹痛（指病历里写到、被记下的那一阵）
G. n. 胃痛、不适（指一件事里人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 不适（抽象总称，指人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: bore the stomachache that no patient in the clinic would have noted
The stomachache, meaning the pain itself and not the bandage
the stomachache at the far bed
the stomachache was the whole of the matter
the stomachache had become a line in a chart
The stomachache of the whole thing
A stomachache, my mother said in 1987

answers.why: bear the stomachache 意为“忍这一阵胃痛”，1978 年那位大夫把卫生所里没有一位病人肯记下的一阵胃痛做了一遍。
stomachache 意为“胃痛；腹痛”，指那阵胃痛本身而不是窄窄的绷带，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记下。
stomachache 意为“胃痛；腹痛”，指卫生所里每一阵旁边的那一阵，每一阵旁边都有同一卷窄窄的绷带。
stomachache 意为“胃痛；腹痛”，指最远那张床边的留给孩子们遮着的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
stomachache 意为“胃痛、不适”，指一件事里人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这阵不适就是那件事的全部。
stomachache 意为“不适”，指人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西而不是那阵胃痛，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
stomachache 意为“胃痛；腹痛”，指病历里写到、被记下的那一阵，到 1983 年这一阵成了病历里的一行。
stomachache 意为“胃痛之事”，大夫一月写道，整件事的胃痛之事是一处卫生所和三个星期的记下。
stomachache 意为“胃痛；腹痛”，我记得的是病历里记下过的那一阵，1985 年养好了，至今仍被说成卫生所里最安静的一阵。
stomachache 为抽象总称，母亲 1987 年说，胃痛是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的胃痛。
